conditions: The read assumes the symbol has a nonvoid default value. Assignment follows the setq-default symbol/form argument syntax.
limitations: Access and assignment here concern default values. Creation of buffer-local bindings and frame-specific behavior have separate rules.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: In GNU Emacs 29.4 Emacs Lisp, default-value reads a symbol's default variable value and setq-default assigns evaluated values to default bindings even when the current buffer has a buffer-local binding.
